value.name: Daniel greets Asha warmly
value.description: Daniel welcomes Asha into the house with a relieved smile and offers her coffee.
evidence: opened and produced a smile that was meant to look like relief.
"Ms. Patel. Thank God. Sit, please. Coffee? Rosa, coffee."

value.name: Asha notices coffee already prepared
value.description: Asha points out that coffee is already waiting on the sideboard, revealing Rosa prepared it before Daniel asked.
evidence: There was already a tray on the sideboard, a silver pot, three cups, cream in a small pitcher, sugar in a bowl with a tiny spoon.
Rosa had made it before Asha arrived, before Daniel asked.

value.name: Daniel fails to notice Rosa's preparation
value.description: Daniel does not seem to register that coffee was already made, suggesting his inattentiveness or preoccupation.
evidence: Rosa had made it before Asha arrived, before Daniel asked. Daniel did not appear to notice.

value.name: Lucia sits withdrawn at the table
value.description: Lucia is introduced as visibly upset and recently crying, holding a mug apart from the prepared tray.
evidence: Lucia was sitting at the far end of the table with her hands wrapped around a mug that was not from the tray.
She was younger than her brother by perhaps six years, dark-haired, wearing a black sweater and jeans, no makeup, the skin under her eyes the color of a bruise that had begun to yellow.
She had been crying recently enough that her voice, when she said "Hi," came out at half its usual register.

value.name: Asha greets Lucia and sits between them
value.description: Asha returns Lucia's greeting and takes a seat positioned between Daniel and Lucia while opening her portfolio.
evidence: "Hi," Asha said back, and took a seat at the side of the table, equidistant from each of them.
She set the portfolio down and opened it without looking at the contents

value.name: Asha studies the room instead of the portfolio
value.description: Asha deliberately avoids looking at the portfolio contents because she already knows them and wants to observe the people in the room.
evidence: because she already knew what was in it and she wanted to watch the room instead.

value.name: Daniel explains the unusual house meeting
value.description: Daniel says he appreciates Asha coming to the house and frames the meeting as necessary for discussing matters in context.
evidence: "I appreciate you coming to the house. I know it isn't standard. But there are things here we need to discuss in context"

value.name: Daniel reveals Lucia has stayed home all week
value.description: Daniel begins to explain Lucia's situation, then revises his wording and says she has preferred to stay in the house this week.
evidence: He glanced at his sister and visibly chose another word.
"Lucia has preferred to stay in the house this week, and it seemed easier."

value.name: Asha agrees to the house visit
value.description: Asha reassures Daniel that the arrangement is fine and says she prefers to inspect the property in person.
evidence: "It's fine," Asha said. "I prefer to see the property in any case."
